about: Venus in each of the twelve bhavas.

rules.says: Easy to be around and aware of it; presentation matters, and comfort is not readily given up.
Money arrives through taste rather than toil; a pleasant speaker who eats and spends well.
Effort goes into something made rather than something won; relations with siblings are warm.
A home worth coming back to, vehicles, and genuine affection from the mother.
Romance and creative work are the same impulse here; affectionate with children and drawn to performance.
Indulgence turns into debt and relationships into disputes; the body objects to what is enjoyed too often.
Partnership is central to the life and sought early; attractive to others and skilled at keeping the peace.
Attachments run private and sometimes concealed; money can come through the partner, and the interest in what is forbidden is real.
Fortunate and refined; belief is aesthetic as much as moral, and travel is for pleasure as well as learning.
A career in art, luxury, design or diplomacy; charm does work that effort would otherwise have to.
Income from what people enjoy, and a circle that is both pleasant and profitable.
Classically the house where Venus enjoys most and keeps least: private pleasure, foreign comfort, and spending that cannot be accounted for.
